devices.title: Devices
devices.hint: The {app} app on iPhone, iPad and Mac. Every device has its own key. Disconnect one, and it loses access at once.
devices.full: {max} devices are connected already, no more fit. Disconnect one to connect a new one.
devices.askDisconnectText: The device loses access at once and gets no more notifications. What the app has stored there stays on the device until someone deletes the app. You can connect it again any time.
devices.askAllText: Every iPhone, iPad and Mac loses access at once. Browsers and API keys stay. To go on working, connect each device again.

rename.title: Rename device
rename.name: Name
rename.hint: As it shows in this list and in the app. Since iOS 16 an iPhone tells the app only its model, so a name of your own helps when several of the same kind are connected.

pair.title: Connect iPhone or iPad
pair.intro: Scan the code with the device's camera or in the {app} app under “Add server”.
pair.step1: Get {app} from the App Store if it is not there yet.
pair.step2: Point the camera at the code.
pair.valid: Valid for {time} more minutes, for one device.
pair.noCamera: Without a camera, on a Mac for instance: choose “Type code” in the app.
pair.operatorOff: You can turn it on under Server › Connections.
pair.pairedText: It is in your list of devices now. You can change its name there.

push.title: Notifications on your devices
push.hint: Every device has its own choice.
push.inApp: The app shows the same ticks under Settings › Notifications.
push.inAppLater: The ticks apply already. {app} on the device lets you choose them with a coming version of the app.
push.none: No device connected yet. You connect iPhone and iPad under My account › Connections.
push.systemOffText: This device has not signed up for notifications from {app}, or iOS has turned them off there. The ticks apply as soon as it gets them again.
push.noKinds: There are no notifications to choose for this device yet.

account.title: Devices
account.resting: resting while the account is blocked
account.askText: Every iPhone, iPad and Mac of the account loses access at once. {name} can connect them again any time.
account.privacy: You see only how many, which kind and when last; never what is on the devices.

connect.title: Connect the {app} app to your account?
connect.text: The app gets the same rights as you have in the browser.
connect.invalid: The {app} app opens this page itself. Start connecting in the app.
connect.cancelled: Not connected. You can close this window.

way.none: No device connected yet; you connect one under “Connections”.
way.some: {devices} connected, notifications allowed on {push}. What arrives there you choose per device, below or in the app.

errors.too_many_pairings: Too many codes are open. Close another window or wait ten minutes.
errors.too_many_devices: {max} devices are connected already, no more fit. Disconnect one to connect a new one.
errors.app_disabled: The operator has turned the app off.
errors.app_pairing_disabled: The operator is not letting new devices in right now.
errors.name_invalid: The name must not be empty and may have at most 80 characters.
errors.browser_only: This works only in the browser.
errors.too_many_attempts: Too many attempts. Try again in a moment.
errors.pairing_gone: The code is no longer valid. Show a new one.
errors.second_factor_required: Set up a second factor first.
errors.invalid_input: That does not fit. Reload the page and try again.
errors.app_address_missing: The server does not know its public address. The operator sets it.
errors.kind_unknown: This kind of notification no longer exists here. Reload the page.

failed: That did not work. Please try again.
